film.title: Ek patta, alag starch results: kyun?
film.look: 16:9 photoreal school-botany bench journey, golden window light and teal shadows; living tissue emerald, variegated margins cream, black paper matte black, glass transparent, KOH cotton ivory, iodine amber-brown, starch-positive tissue blue-black and starch-negative tissue pale cream; preserve left-right placement through close-ups.

shots.title: Ek hi patta, alag jawaab
shots.key: Starch ka result har hisse mein ek jaisa kyun nahi?

visual.image_prompt: 16:9 photoreal school botany bench in golden window light, teal shaded background. Two small potted plants and a broad white testing tray beneath them. Left plant has emerald-and-cream variegated leaves; right plant has emerald leaves, one with a matte black paper band covering its middle on both faces. Tray centered at 55,72 contains two shallow white dishes, left below variegated plant and right below covered plant; amber iodine dropper at edge. Living leaves only, no microscopic objects. Realistic veins and materials. Leave upper left open for light animation and labels, and dish interiors clear for subsequent testing. No printed labels.

sentences.roman: Patta light mein hai, phir bhi iodine test mein poora blue-black kyun nahi hota?
sentences.voice: पत्ता लाइट में है, फिर भी आयोडीन टेस्ट में पूरा ब्लू-ब्लैक क्यों नहीं होता?

sentences.roman: Aaiye jaante hain; pehle photosynthesis ke baare mein apni pehle ki samajh ko in patton par parakhte hain.
sentences.voice: आइए जानते हैं; पहले फोटोसिंथेसिस के बारे में अपनी पहले की समझ को इन पत्तों पर परखते हैं।

sentences.roman: Photosynthesis se bana kuch khana starch ban kar jama hota hai, aur iodine us starch ko blue-black dikhata hai.
sentences.voice: फोटोसिंथेसिस से बना कुछ खाना स्टार्च बन कर जमा होता है, और आयोडीन उस स्टार्च को ब्लू-ब्लैक दिखाता है।
sentences.beyond: Starch ko stored food aur iodine ko uska indicator samjhaya.

sentences.roman: Controlled experiments mein ek baar mein ek zaroorat badalte hain, jaise recipe mein ek ingredient hata kar uska kaam jaanchte hain.
sentences.voice: कंट्रोल्ड एक्सपेरिमेंट्स में एक बार में एक ज़रूरत बदलते हैं, जैसे रेसिपी में एक इंग्रीडिएंट हटा कर उसका काम जाँचते हैं।
sentences.beyond: Controlled comparison ka logic aur recipe ki misaal di.

shots.title: Green hissa kya batata hai?
shots.key: Chlorophyll wale illuminated hisse mein starch milta hai.

visual.image_prompt: 16:9 closer photographic view inside the previous white testing tray, same golden window light and teal shadows. Two dishes: large left dish centered 32,55 holds a flattened variegated leaf after chlorophyll removal and iodine testing; originally emerald central islands now sharply blue-black, originally cream margins remain pale cream. Preserve recognizable irregular variegation boundaries. Right dish centered 77,56 holds an iodine-tested ordinary leaf with blue-black exposed tip and base and a pale cream transverse central band; removed matte black paper band rests immediately above right dish at 77,29. An amber-brown iodine dropper tip enters above left leaf at 28,25. Leaves wet and realistic, not diagrams. Open space for animated iodine drops, no text.

sentences.roman: Ab tray mein variegated leaf aur black paper se partially covered leaf ka starch test dekhte hain; dono ko light milti hai.
sentences.voice: अब ट्रे में वैरिगेटेड लीफ और ब्लैक पेपर से पार्शियली कवर्ड लीफ का स्टार्च टेस्ट देखते हैं; दोनों को लाइट मिलती है।

sentences.roman: Pehle plant ko andhere mein destarch karte hain; test se pehle patte ka rang hot-water bath mein alcohol se hataate hain.
sentences.voice: पहले प्लांट को अँधेरे में डीस्टार्च करते हैं; टेस्ट से पहले पत्ते का रंग हॉट-वॉटर बाथ में ऐल्कोहॉल से हटाते हैं।
sentences.beyond: Purana starch hatane aur iodine ka rang saaf dekhne ki preparation batayi; alcohol ko water bath mein garam kiya.

sentences.roman: Ab iodine padne par kaunsa hissa blue-black hota hai?
sentences.voice: अब आयोडीन पड़ने पर कौन-सा हिस्सा ब्लू-ब्लैक होता है?

sentences.roman: Dekhiye, pehle green rahe hisse blue-black hain; wahin chlorophyll, yaani green pigment, hone se light mein starch banta hai.
sentences.voice: देखिए, पहले ग्रीन रहे हिस्से ब्लू-ब्लैक हैं; वहीं क्लोरोफिल, यानी ग्रीन पिगमेंट, होने से लाइट में स्टार्च बनता है।

shots.title: Paper ke neeche kya badla?
shots.key: Green hona kaafi nahi; light bhi chahiye.

visual.image_prompt: 16:9 macro inside the previous right-hand dish, same white ceramic, golden illumination and teal shadows. Same tested ordinary leaf fills frame vertically, tip at 60,20 and base at 59,83. Its exposed tip and base are iodine blue-black; its formerly black-paper-covered transverse middle from y43 to y59 remains pale cream after decolorization and iodine. Matte black removed paper band rests above and right at 80,18, matching previous right placement. Amber iodine dropper above left at 25,24, clear approach to pale band and blue-black tip. Real wet tissue, visible veins, no green pigment remaining, no text. Leave left side open for labels.

sentences.roman: Ab isi covered leaf ke paas hain; paper hatne ke baad beech ka band alag dikh raha hai.
sentences.voice: अब इसी कवर्ड लीफ के पास हैं; पेपर हटने के बाद बीच का बैंड अलग दिख रहा है।

sentences.roman: Poora patta green tha, toh paper ke neeche starch kyun nahi milta?
sentences.voice: पूरा पत्ता ग्रीन था, तो पेपर के नीचे स्टार्च क्यों नहीं मिलता?

sentences.roman: Aisa isliye hai kyunki black paper light rokta hai, jaise band parda dhoop rokta hai; iodine sirf illuminated hisse ko blue-black dikhata hai.
sentences.voice: ऐसा इसलिए है क्योंकि ब्लैक पेपर लाइट रोकता है, जैसे बंद पर्दा धूप रोकता है; आयोडीन सिर्फ़ इल्यूमिनेटेड हिस्से को ब्लू-ब्लैक दिखाता है।
sentences.beyond: Paper ki light-blocking action ko parde se joda.

shots.title: CO2 ko hata kar dekhein
shots.key: KOH tube ke andar ki CO2 absorb karta hai.

visual.image_prompt: 16:9 photoreal botanical experiment on same golden-lit teal-shadow bench. An attached broad emerald leaf extends horizontally from its living plant on left into a large clear glass test tube on right. Leaf outer basal half remains in room air at x32,y44; distal half inside tube at x68,y44. Tube axis horizontal with slightly lower closed end at right; airtight split rubber stopper seals around leaf at x49,y44 without crushing it. Ivory KOH-soaked cotton rests at closed end x85,y59, below and not touching leaf. Transparent tube walls show all tissue. Strong window illumination reaches both halves equally. No painted molecules. Empty air above leaf and inside tube for CO2 motion; no text.

sentences.roman: Ab CO2 ka experiment dekhte hain; is green leaf ka ek hissa test tube mein hai aur doosra air mein khula hai.
sentences.voice: अब सी ओ टू का एक्सपेरिमेंट देखते हैं; इस ग्रीन लीफ का एक हिस्सा टेस्ट ट्यूब में है और दूसरा एयर में खुला है।

sentences.roman: Tube mein KOH-soaked cotton hai; lekin yeh cotton CO2 ki supply ko kaise badalta hai?
sentences.voice: ट्यूब में के ओ एच-सोक्ड कॉटन है; लेकिन यह कॉटन सी ओ टू की सप्लाई को कैसे बदलता है?

sentences.roman: Dekhiye, KOH CO2 absorb karta hai, jisse tube ke andar leaf ko CO2 nahi milti.
sentences.voice: देखिए, के ओ एच सी ओ टू ऐब्ज़ॉर्ब करता है, जिससे ट्यूब के अंदर लीफ को सी ओ टू नहीं मिलती।

sentences.roman: Ab setup ko kuch samay light mein rakhte hain, taaki dono hisson ko light milti rahe.
sentences.voice: अब सेटअप को कुछ समय लाइट में रखते हैं, ताकि दोनों हिस्सों को लाइट मिलती रहे।

shots.title: Dono hisson ka fair comparison
shots.key: Light aur chlorophyll same; CO2 ki availability alag.

sentences.roman: Ab tube ki boundary paas se dekhte hain; seal bahar ki air ko andar aane se rokta hai.
sentences.voice: अब ट्यूब की बाउंड्री पास से देखते हैं; सील बाहर की एयर को अंदर आने से रोकता है।
sentences.beyond: Airtight seal ka experimental control samjhaya.

sentences.roman: Ab sawaal banta hai ki CO2 zaroori hone ka conclusion kaise nikaalein?
sentences.voice: अब सवाल बनता है कि सी ओ टू ज़रूरी होने का कन्क्लूज़न कैसे निकालें?

sentences.roman: Is conclusion ki wajah samajhiye: dono taraf chlorophyll aur light hain, par air wala hissa CO2 paata rehta hai.
sentences.voice: इस कन्क्लूज़न की वजह समझिए: दोनों तरफ़ क्लोरोफिल और लाइट हैं, पर एयर वाला हिस्सा सी ओ टू पाता रहता है।
sentences.beyond: Same leaf ke do hisson ko internal comparison ki tarah samjhaya.

sentences.roman: Andar KOH CO2 hata deta hai, jaise recipe ka ek ingredient gayab ho; ab isi patte ka starch test karte hain.
sentences.voice: अंदर के ओ एच सी ओ टू हटा देता है, जैसे रेसिपी का एक इंग्रीडिएंट गायब हो; अब इसी पत्ते का स्टार्च टेस्ट करते हैं।
sentences.beyond: Missing ingredient ki misaal se necessity ka logic joda.

shots.title: Iodine deta hai saboot

sentences.roman: Ab isi patte ka rang hata kar iodine daalte hain; kya dono hisse blue-black honge?
sentences.voice: अब इसी पत्ते का रंग हटा कर आयोडीन डालते हैं; क्या दोनों हिस्से ब्लू-ब्लैक होंगे?

sentences.roman: Dekhiye, air mein khula hissa starch-positive, yaani blue-black hai, par tube wala hissa starch-negative rehta hai.
sentences.voice: देखिए, एयर में खुला हिस्सा स्टार्च-पॉज़िटिव, यानी ब्लू-ब्लैक है, पर ट्यूब वाला हिस्सा स्टार्च-नेगेटिव रहता है।

sentences.roman: Isliye conclusion nikalta hai ki CO2 photosynthesis ke liye zaroori hai; sirf green hona aur light milna kaafi nahi hai.
sentences.voice: इसलिए कन्क्लूज़न निकलता है कि सी ओ टू फोटोसिंथेसिस के लिए ज़रूरी है; सिर्फ़ ग्रीन होना और लाइट मिलना काफ़ी नहीं है।

book line B9 is listed in teaches, but none of its key words is spoken there: Can you explain how this conclusion could be drawn?

book_lines.text: Let us try to find out what we already know about photosynthesis.

Some 11.8 The C4 Pathway simple experiments you may have done in the earlier classes have shown that chlorophyll (green pigment of the leaf), light and CO are required for 11.9 hotorespiration 2 photosynthesis to occur.

11.10Factors You may have carried out the experiment to look for starch formation affecting in two leaves – a variegated leaf or a leaf that was partially covered with Photosynthesis black paper, and exposed to light.
On testing these leaves for the presence of starch it was clear that photosynthesis occurred only in the green parts of the leaves in the presence of light.
Another experiment you may have carried out where a part of a leaf is enclosed in a test tube containing some KOH soaked cotton (which absorbs CO2 ), while the other half is exposed to air.
The setup is then placed in light for some time.

On testing for the presence of starch later in the two parts of the leaf, you must have found that the exposed part of the leaf tested positive for starch while the portion that was in the tube, tested negative.
This showed that CO2 was required for photosynthesis.
Can you explain how this conclusion could be drawn?
